--- title: "Quick Start: Conformal Regression" description: "Wrap any scikit-learn model with statistically rigorous coverage guarantees using ConformalRegressor" date: today format: html: self-contained: true embed-resources: true code-fold: true code-tools: true --- # Quick Start: Conformal Regression Wrap any scikit-learn model with **statistically rigorous coverage guarantees** using `ConformalRegressor`. This notebook demonstrates the core workflow: 1. Load tabular data (concrete compressive strength) 2. Wrap a GradientBoostingRegressor with conformal prediction 3. Extract intervals, quantiles, and samples from predictions 4. Evaluate calibration ## Setup ::: {#setup .cell cache='true' execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import polars as pl from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingRegressor from sklearn.linear_model import Ridge from uncertainty_flow.metrics import coverage_score, winkler_score from uncertainty_flow.utils.split import select_validation_plan from uncertainty_flow.wrappers import ConformalRegressor ``` ::: ## Configuration ::: {#config .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} target_col = "strength" base_model_choice = "GradientBoosting" coverage_target = 0.9 ``` ::: ## Load Data ::: {#cell-load-data .cell cache='true' execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} df = pl.read_parquet("../data/concrete.parquet") print(f"Dataset shape: {df.shape}") df.head(10) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Dataset shape: (1030, 9) ``` ::: ::: {#load-data .cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ```{=html}

``` ::: ::: ## Train / Test Split ::: {#split .cell cache='true' execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} plan = select_validation_plan(df, task_type="tabular", random_state=42) train_df, test_df = plan.outer_split actuals = test_df[target_col] print(f"Strategy: {plan.metadata.strategy_name} | Train: {len(train_df)} | Test: {len(test_df)}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Strategy: random_holdout | Train: 824 | Test: 206 ``` ::: ::: ## Train Conformal Model ::: {#train .cell cache='true' execution_count=5} ``` {.python .cell-code} base_cls = GradientBoostingRegressor if base_model_choice == "GradientBoosting" else Ridge base = base_cls(random_state=42) model = ConformalRegressor( base_model=base, coverage_target=coverage_target, auto_tune=True, random_state=42, ) model.fit(train_df, target=target_col) print(model) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` ``` ::: ::: ## Predict ::: {#predict .cell cache='true' execution_count=6} ``` {.python .cell-code} pred = model.predict(test_df) print(pred) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` DistributionPrediction(n=206, targets=['strength'], quantiles=11) ``` ::: ::: ## Intervals ::: {#intervals .cell execution_count=7} ``` {.python .cell-code} interval_df = pred.interval(confidence=coverage_target) print(interval_df.head(10)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` shape: (10, 2) ┌───────────┬───────────┐ │ lower ┆ upper │ │ --- ┆ --- │ │ f64 ┆ f64 │ ╞═══════════╪═══════════╡ │ 22.110626 ┆ 44.408737 │ │ 32.811675 ┆ 55.109786 │ │ 18.645393 ┆ 40.943503 │ │ 29.667123 ┆ 51.965233 │ │ 45.17357 ┆ 67.471681 │ │ 51.278542 ┆ 73.576653 │ │ 41.838935 ┆ 64.137045 │ │ 45.657346 ┆ 67.955457 │ │ 40.093668 ┆ 62.391779 │ │ 45.044928 ┆ 67.343038 │ └───────────┴───────────┘ ``` ::: ::: ## Quantiles ::: {#quantiles .cell execution_count=8} ``` {.python .cell-code} quantiles_df = pred.quantile([0.05, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.95]) print(quantiles_df.head(10)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` shape: (10, 5) ┌───────────┬───────────┬───────────┬───────────┬───────────┐ │ q_0.050 ┆ q_0.250 ┆ q_0.500 ┆ q_0.750 ┆ q_0.950 │ │ --- ┆ --- ┆ --- ┆ --- ┆ --- │ │ f64 ┆ f64 ┆ f64 ┆ f64 ┆ f64 │ ╞═══════════╪═══════════╪═══════════╪═══════════╪═══════════╡ │ 22.110626 ┆ 25.803339 ┆ 28.761976 ┆ 30.688535 ┆ 44.408737 │ │ 32.811675 ┆ 36.504388 ┆ 39.463025 ┆ 41.389584 ┆ 55.109786 │ │ 18.645393 ┆ 22.338105 ┆ 25.296742 ┆ 27.223302 ┆ 40.943503 │ │ 29.667123 ┆ 33.359835 ┆ 36.318472 ┆ 38.245032 ┆ 51.965233 │ │ 45.17357 ┆ 48.866283 ┆ 51.82492 ┆ 53.751479 ┆ 67.471681 │ │ 51.278542 ┆ 54.971255 ┆ 57.929891 ┆ 59.856451 ┆ 73.576653 │ │ 41.838935 ┆ 45.531647 ┆ 48.490284 ┆ 50.416844 ┆ 64.137045 │ │ 45.657346 ┆ 49.350059 ┆ 52.308695 ┆ 54.235255 ┆ 67.955457 │ │ 40.093668 ┆ 43.786381 ┆ 46.745018 ┆ 48.671577 ┆ 62.391779 │ │ 45.044928 ┆ 48.73764 ┆ 51.696277 ┆ 53.622837 ┆ 67.343038 │ └───────────┴───────────┴───────────┴───────────┴───────────┘ ``` ::: ::: ## Mean ::: {#mean .cell execution_count=9} ``` {.python .cell-code} mean_series = pred.mean() print(mean_series.head(10)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` shape: (10,) Series: 'mean' [f64] [ 28.761976 39.463025 25.296742 36.318472 51.82492 57.929891 48.490284 52.308695 46.745018 51.696277 ] ``` ::: ::: ## Evaluate Coverage ::: {#evaluate .cell execution_count=10} ``` {.python .cell-code} interval = pred.interval(confidence=coverage_target) coverage = coverage_score(actuals, interval["lower"], interval["upper"]) winkler = winkler_score( actuals, interval["lower"], interval["upper"], confidence=coverage_target ) print(f"Coverage: {coverage:.3f} | Winkler score: {winkler:.2f}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Coverage: 0.262 | Winkler score: 187.62 ``` ::: ::: ## Prediction Plot ::: {#cell-plot .cell execution_count=11} ``` {.python .cell-code} fig = pred.plot( actuals=actuals, confidence_bands=[0.5, 0.8, coverage_target], title=f"Conformal Prediction — {target_col}", ) fig ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ![](01_quick_start_files/figure-html/plot-output-1.png){#plot width=1142 height=566} ::: ::: ## Calibration Report ::: {#calibration .cell execution_count=12} ``` {.python .cell-code} calibration = model.calibration_report(test_df, target_col) print(calibration) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` shape: (3, 5) ┌──────────┬────────────────────┬───────────────────┬───────────┬───────────────┐ │ quantile ┆ requested_coverage ┆ achieved_coverage ┆ sharpness ┆ winkler_score │ │ --- ┆ --- ┆ --- ┆ --- ┆ --- │ │ f64 ┆ f64 ┆ f64 ┆ f64 ┆ f64 │ ╞══════════╪════════════════════╪═══════════════════╪═══════════╪═══════════════╡ │ 0.8 ┆ 0.8 ┆ 0.15534 ┆ 13.048938 ┆ 110.257265 │ │ 0.9 ┆ 0.9 ┆ 0.262136 ┆ 22.298111 ┆ 187.615263 │ │ 0.95 ┆ 0.95 ┆ 0.262136 ┆ 22.298111 ┆ 352.932416 │ └──────────┴────────────────────┴───────────────────┴───────────┴───────────────┘ ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` /Users/minghao/Desktop/personal/uncertainty_flow/uncertainty_flow/core/base.py:83: UncertaintyFlowWarning: Requested 0.8 coverage but achieved 0.16.
